onboarding.permissions.intro: Condura needs two permissions to control your computer. Grant them now for the full experience, or skip and enable later in Settings.
onboarding.permissions.title: Grant access
onboarding.permissions.why_accessibility: Lets Condura click, type, and read UI elements in other apps.
onboarding.permissions.why_automation: Lets Condura send AppleEvents to other apps so 'click Safari in the corner' just works.
onboarding.permissions.why_body: Condura runs locally and asks the operating system for access to other apps and your screen — just like a screen reader or automation tool. You can revoke any of these anytime in System Settings.
onboarding.permissions.why_microphone: Lets Condura hear you for voice commands and wake-word detection.
onboarding.permissions.why_notifications: Lets Condura ping you when an agent finishes, hits a wall, or needs your attention.
onboarding.permissions.why_screen_record: Lets Condura see your screen to understand what to do.
